set.body: PLS Neuro Handoff A7 needs scientific admission to inspect the actual fixed-effects pooling policy without retaining a complete runwise fit. EstimateExecutionDescription reports pooled topology, run preparations and diagnostics but omits the FixedEffectsPolicy already owned by FirstLevelFixedEffectsEstimatePlan and emitted by every selected block. Add the policy to the public execution description for pooled plans, represent its absence for shared OLS explicitly, cover JVM and Scala.js description tests, and requalify the exact PLS Neuro consumer. Do not duplicate or infer provider policy in the application.
set.title: Expose fixed-effects policy in selected execution descriptions
